basic_profile.bio: I'm a certified pharmacy technician with a passion for gaming and anime. Originally from Chicago, I currently reside in Ithaca, New York, where I work at a local Walgreens. I love exploring the intricate world of Kakegurui in my downtime and staying updated with the latest tech reviews on GamersNexus. I'm usually online in the evenings after my shifts, catching up with my favorite subreddits or seeking advice for my job. I'm single and enjoy the freedom to focus on my hobbies and career.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in pharmacy, having completed a pharmacy technician certification program and accumulated significant work experience over the years. My knowledge also extends to gaming and tech, which I have nurtured through self-teaching and engaging with communities like GamersNexus and forums discussing anime like Kakegurui.
